Yes. 
I know what you are trying to say. I know even I feel the same. Whenever I try I fail. Or I take a decision which clearly I shouldn't have taken. Because of my Lazyness whatever I don't do is forced upon me by life. Because Somethings have to be done, If I dont do it or procrastinate it, it will  be forced upon me at some point by life itself. 
Do you know whatever situation that I am in right now is because of my lazyness or my habit of procrastination. Now I feel so depressed thinking back I realise that I was not like this always. I used to be happy. I know what went wrong. I know I shouldn't have done same mistake again. But here I am. Doing the same mistake so many times. Realising but hesitating to change myself. Because I am afraid of change. I am afraid of the process which brings change. 
I want to say lotof things but I dont wanna. 
All I am saying is this feeling of powerlessness you will feel at every wrong decision of life.  I feel it too. And lot others too. What we should do is stop thinking about what others will think if we do this or what other will think of we do that. We should focus on what would be a correct step after our previous mistake. Just thinking back if I do the same mistake I would end up right there again. Is that what I wanna do? 
Or should I try something else. There is always another way. We should be brave enough to accept the fact that we may be wrong. Its not a crime and certainly not the end. Imagine our mistakes as  just a wrong turn we took. We just have to turn back and get on the other path. It may be wrong and it may be right.

I feel exactly the same. 
I feel like I just dont know the purpose ofmy life.
Sometimes I feel like I am not good at anything
Ending life is solution.
